retrospective_crossover.primary_observation: A1 plus the public causal selector at K=32 dominated both prior setup-specific baselines

proposal.family: pinned historical public A1 affine lens
proposal.ordering: score descending; token ID ascending for exact ties

selector.public_surrogate: pinned public Llama embedding plus decoder layers 0,1,2,3
selector.base_score: uncentered cosine between public-prefix simulation and observed cut-4 activation
selector.confidence: (largest K32 score minus second-largest K32 score) divided by RMS deviation of the 32 scores from their mean
selector.confidence_invariance: unchanged by a common score shift or positive rescaling
selector.routing: simulate ranks 33-64 exactly when normalized confidence is less than or equal to the frozen threshold
selector.commit: highest causal score among evaluated candidates; proposal rank resolves exact score ties

public_development.source: the 32 public development records fixed in experiments/TRR-0001/plan.json
public_development.truth_status: public auxiliary labels; never an evaluated canonical or fresh blind split
public_development.update_training_source: the 64 public target_update_train records fixed in experiments/TRR-0001/plan.json; disjoint from development

conditions.role: held-out public validation; forbidden for threshold selection or revision
conditions.training_records: all 64 target_update_train records in reverse fixed order

threshold_fit.candidate_thresholds: numeric no-expansion sentinel -1.0, numeric all-expansion sentinel 1000000.0, and the pooled K32 normalized-gap quantiles 0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.35, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00 computed on fit conditions only
threshold_fit.evaluation: run the complete online causal decode independently at each candidate threshold

selection_rule.when_full_k64_beats_k32: require at least 90% of the pooled public-development correct-token gain from full K64 over K32; among qualifying thresholds choose the fewest logical simulations, then the smaller numeric threshold
selection_rule.otherwise: maximize pooled public-development correct tokens; tie-break by fewer logical simulations, then the smaller numeric threshold

threshold_fit.held_out_policy: report the frozen threshold on public_lora_2603 without changing it
threshold_fit.freeze: commit exact threshold, fit table, commands, code hash, public update hashes, and public observation hashes before any fresh blind selection exists

fresh_blind_confirmation.creation_order: only after the frozen calibration commit
fresh_blind_confirmation.selection: evaluator-private cryptographic key and opaque public HMAC commitment
fresh_blind_confirmation.access_boundary: separate minimal chroot with read-only code, public model, lens, calibration, and sanitized observations; no workspace, dataset, target update, truth, private selection, or network
fresh_blind_confirmation.freeze_order: predictions, candidates, confidence, routing, timing, access evidence, and hashes frozen before selection reveal or truth opening

dual_setup_evaluation.new_setup: fresh 64x40 Pile/unavailable-LoRA cut-4 confirmation plus the canonical retrospective setup for direct comparability
dual_setup_evaluation.historical_setup: canonical 128x128 Finance strict-BOS source capture, retrospective only
dual_setup_evaluation.frozen_method_state: identical A1 lens, confidence definition, threshold, budgets, and routing rule

revision_policy: No threshold, candidate budget, routing rule, method code, or public state may change after the calibration freeze. Any later variant is exploratory and requires a new preregistration.
